messages:
maria.cs: Hey team — Iris Health confirmed for Preview Cohort 3! They signed the T&Cs and want to kick off next week. Need SE + onboarding slot. :tada:

jake.se: Woo! I'm available Tue/Wed mornings PT. What's their timezone?

maria.cs: They're on EST (NY). Prefer mornings there. Can we do Wed 10am EST (Wed 14th)?

samir.eng: Wed 14th 10am EST works for me. I'll prep a quick environment check doc. Any perf constraints?

aisha.ps: Quick note — they plan to use embeddings + chat routing. Recommend quantized 13B for cost/latency tradeoff. I'll attach config suggestions.

maria.cs: Good call. Also flagged renewal sensitivity — high. Iris wants measurable success in first 30 days. CS to own adoption milestones.

jake.se: I'll own the kickoff demo and walkthrough. Plan to show: auth, sample prompts, rerank config, and fallback policy. Can someone share the onboarding checklist?

maria.cs: Pasting checklist here:

```
- invite workspace
- grant API key (preview)
- verify VPC egress (if private)
- run sample eval prompts
- collect baseline tokens / latency
```

samir.eng: I'll run a capacity check on our Dedicated pool before the call. Ping me the customer API host once provisioned.

aisha.ps: I'll prepare a one-pager with best prompts, quant tips, and expected token counts. ETA EOD Mon.

maria.cs: Assigning action items: @jake.se demo, @samir.eng infra check, @aisha.ps prompt doc. I'll schedule the meeting and send calendar invite.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: Iris Health Kickoff — Wed 2024-08-14 10:00 EST — zoom link <https://zoom.us/j/123456789> :calendar:

jake.se: Added to calendar. Any pre-reads we should send the customer?

maria.cs: Sending a 2-line prep note now and copying you all. Also asking for sample payloads.

maria.cs: Draft to customer: "Thanks — looking forward. Please run this quick curl to sanity-check the endpoint:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://preview.api.redwood.ai/v1/health

and paste the output if you hit any errors." — cc @jake.se

aisha.ps: Small ask — could we get a sample data schema and 3 anonymized examples? That'll help tailor prompt templates.

maria.cs: Asked Iris for sample payloads and a short list of business objectives. Will update thread when received. :pray:

jake.se: I'll prep 3 demo prompts that highlight fallback routing + rerank.

maria.cs: Last operational question — any blockers for seat provisioning or logs access? @samir.eng

samir.eng: No blockers. Provisioned 2 preview seats and enabled verbose logging for the session. Will run a smoke test tomorrow and post logs if anything odd.

maria.cs: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the confirmed invite and the customer prep note. :rocket:
